title: Watch: Flock of turkeys chases woman on Massachusetts sidewalk
summary: The woman said she had to jump into a stranger's car to escape a flock of turkeys that chased her down the sidewalk.

blocks.text: Two people were driving when they encountered a woman being chased by turkeys down the sidewalk in Newton, Massachusetts. The woman said she had to jump into a stranger's car to escape them. No injuries were reported to the woman or the turkeys.
